mentions.name: ProForta
mentions.description: This prototype app implements a self-sovereign AI architecture for health data: users gain control over their health data wherever it resides, AI agents go to the user's data to gather insights, and raw data custody remains where it was created.
mentions.problem: Individuals lack control over their health data, which typically sits under third-party custody rather than their own.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building ProForta.com, a prototype app for a self-sovereign AI architecture where you gain control over your health data wherever it resides, the AIs go to your data to gather insights, and raw data custody remains where it was created.
mentions.author: enbarca
